question:

Statements:

All pillows are beds.

No table is a bed.

Some tables are chairs.

Conclusions:

I. No pillow is a table.

II. Some chairs are pillows.

III. No bed is a chair.
options:
Only conclusion II follows.

Only conclusion I follows.

Both conclusions I and II follow.

Both conclusions I and III follow.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. Only conclusion I follows.

Conclusion I: No pillow is a table - True (As all pillows are beds and no bed is the table)

Conclusion II: Some chairs are pillows - False (There is no information about that)

question:
Consider the given two statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions is logical, and definitely follow(s) from the two given statements.

Statement:

1) No window is a fish.

2) All fishes are men.

Conclusions:

1. No window is a man.

2. No man is a window,

3. Some men are fishes.

4. All men are fishes.
options:
Only conclusions 2 and 4 follow

Only conclusions 1 and 3 follow

Only conclusion 3 follows

All the four conclusions follow
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. Only conclusion 3 follows.

The least possible Venn Diagram for the given statements is drawn below:

Conclusions:

1. No window is a man → False (It is possible, but no definite conclusion can be drawn.)

2. No man is a window → False (It is possible, but no definite conclusion can be drawn.)

3. Some men are fishes → True (As all fishes are men so, some men are fishes is also true.)

4. All men are fishes → False (It is possible, but no definite conclusion can be drawn.)

दिए गए दो कथनों को सत्य मानते हुए, भले ही वे सामान्य ज्ञात तथ्यों से भिन्न प्रतीत होते हों, निर्णय लीजिए कि दिए गए निष्कर्षों में से कौन सा तर्कसंगत है, और निश्चित रूप से दिए गए दो कथनों का अनुसरण करता है।

2. कोई पुरुष खिड़की नहीं है

question:

(B) केवल निष्कर्ष (ii) अनुसरण करता है
